name: Selm (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Selm (a tree beneath three roses on red and yellow).
history: The arms were approved together with a seal and a banner on 1 August 1977 by the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg; red and gold are the colours of the Prince-Bishopric of Münster, to which Selm formerly belonged, and of the lords of Cappenberg.
